facts.fact: 男孩一家告别：Florence 前男孩不动——「Australia is a place I would like to go to … Australia is a dream」；Katy 赠言「Keep up with your schoolwork, and you'll have a brilliant life」——男孩理想＝chess grandmaster or astronomer——「believe in yourself」→「I do」；Florence 主站挥手作别（新乘客未至、四座独享）；Katy 的男孩判词：amazing、beautiful accent、running rings around his poor old parents（dumbfounded by his verbality/intelligence/knowledge；父亲 completely out of his depth）——父母住伦敦、男孩读英式寄宿学校（校名没问出来）；「How did we produce such a son?」。

私密对话开启（封锁 Chip 的指令：say you're entertaining me）：Gloria-同床之问——叙述者早有答案（love–hate 二十年、inconsistent and intermittent relationship）——「Because Gloria is mercurial, and you're adaptable」；叙述者的 Gloria 初恋记忆：交往才几周、不打招呼带一张前男友运来的 double bed 进他房间、命他扔掉旧床；Katy 的 Gloria 画像：wilful and determined、creates her own reality、口头禅「When you're as beautiful as I am, you can get away with anything」（pretty 而非 beautiful 但说得男人们信）；只爱 falling-in-love 阶段（conquering phase——set sights→seduce→测自己有多大 power）——「we have both been on the receiving end of her wiles and stratagems」；封号 Grand Seductress＝她回忆录的书名（if she ever writes one）；「Everybody wants to be a writer」；Gloria 有趣但 totally unreliable——需要 steadier and less mercurial 的人。

男孩走后的课程报告：Milky Way 的 radio waves 或是地外文明的 interstellar signalling、宇宙永远膨胀、我们的宇宙或属更大宇宙的一部分——语言在英语/法语/俄语间 effortless 轮切；伦敦计划：巴黎一周后赴伦敦看 Globe Theatre（叙述者刚看过 Twelfth Night——午后场、戏在观众席里发生、烈日下两名 groundlings 半小时就晕倒——「The medic was busier than some of the supporting actors on stage」）。
facts.anchor: He was telling his mother that the Milky Way emits radio waves

facts.fact: Katy 的舞台往事：大学演过 Ophelia（the doomed Ophelia）、一度想以表演为业；Albee《Who's Afraid of Virginia Woolf?》饰 Martha——harrowing、五晚连演 did my head in——演到后来恨透饰 George 的演员（对方 perfectly reasonable、她曾有点心动——五晚后 hated every last inch of him）；transference 太强：无法把演员与台上角色分开；正是 Ophelia＋Martha 让她确认自己 mentally 不够强、无法与角色切断——自此告别演员梦；Albee 剧＝illusion and reality（她的最爱主题之一）但 devastating；Taylor/Burton 电影版是 stage-to-film 最佳之一——「It's a play about hatred, when all is said and done」。
facts.anchor: Interesting how strong my transference was

facts.fact: Globe 高温课：26 度的下午直射下更热；工作人员说 30 度天可有 20–40 名 groundlings 晕倒；某夜场《The Tempest》遇狂雷暴雨、groundlings 全湿透——有顶座观众却说那是他们看过最好的《The Tempest》（so atmospheric）；补程：Tate Modern（临 Thames 的窗景看全城）。
facts.anchor: the best production of The Tempest they had ever seen
